rationale: EVIDENCE ACQUISITION. Per the predecessor's P0 reclassification, the LIVE RED is REAL but the production-only composition delta is the unproven region. This ACT adds the four default-off diagnostic observation points that the §17 discriminator tree requires, on top of the EXISTING myc-prime-live-diag surface (no new env flag, no new architecture, no new diagnostic framework). Two new recorders (BIND at buildAgentHooks time, ENTER at the very top of beforeModel body before any short-circuit) and one field extension (lookupKey on recordMycPrimeLiveLookup) close the only two ambiguities the predecessor's evidence left open: (1) was a hook bag ever given to the runtime? (2) did the runtime actually call the hook body even when the body short-circuited? Production semantics are bit-identical when the diagnostic is disabled; LBC-01 proves this with a hard assertion. Conservation: 19/19 LBC + pre-existing live-diag tests, 4/4 auto-injection, 2/2 identity-join, 39/39 dogfood-profile, 3/3 config-builder, all GREEN. tsc --noEmit 0 errors; git diff --check clean. Pre-existing drift on turn-state-writer-provenance WPROV07.1 is independent of this ACT (verified by git stash + re-run on predecessor commit). NO production patch is attempted. NO synthetic RED is manufactured. NO dogfood VSIX is built in this ACT — the live run is the next step. The next ACT acquires the LIVE-typed evidence by running one clean installed-Codium dogfood session with diagnostics enabled and reading the captured trace for the operator's captured MYC_SESSION_ID. The discriminator tree then isolates exactly one of the 6 boundaries in §17.
